name: apigee-templater
description: Provides tooling for feature development of Apigee proxies using YAML, JSON and ZIP formats.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run sync-ai-functions && bun build --sourcemap=none ./src/index.ts ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --target=bun --outdir=./dist && node copy-assets.js
scripts.build:binaries: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --outfile dist/aft-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --outfile dist/aft-linux-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --outfile dist/aft-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --outfile dist/aft-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 ./src/bin/apigee-templater.ts --outfile dist/aft-windows-x64.exe

author: tyler.ayers@gmail.com
